may I come in / you may enter

bg-18-01.why: 열다 has vowel ㅕ, so it attaches -어도 돼요 to ask for permission.

bg-18-01.q: Ask for permission to eat an apple. Use 사과 + object particle -을/를 and 먹다 + -아/어도 돼요?
bg-18-01.why: 먹다 attaches -어도 돼요? to ask permission politely.

steps.en: May I open the window right now?

ko: 안내 직원에게 여기서 사진을 찍어도 돼요라고 물어봤어요.
직원이 밝게 웃으면서 네, 플래시 없이 찍어도 돼요라고 답했어요.
en: Sujin went to an art museum on the weekend.
She asked the information staff, 'May I take pictures here?'
The staff member smiled brightly and replied, 'Yes, you may take pictures without a flash.'

bg-18-01.q: What did Sujin ask the staff member at the art museum?
options: Whether she may take pictures there
Where the gift shop is located
bg-18-01.why: The passage says '여기서 사진을 찍어도 돼요라고 물어봤어요' (Asked if she may take pictures here).

bg-18-01.q: Under what condition is photography allowed in the museum?
options: Only outdoors in the parking lot
bg-18-01.why: The passage states '네, 플래시 없이 찍어도 돼요' (Yes, you may take photos without a flash).

items: I can ask for and grant permission politely using -아/어도 돼요
I can choose accurately between -아도 돼요, -어도 돼요, and 해도 돼요

bg-18-02.hint: You must be sure to take your medicine.
bg-18-02.why: 먹다 has vowel ㅓ, so it attaches -어야 돼요 to express necessity.

bg-18-02.q: State that you must clean your room today. Use 방 + object particle -을/를 and 청소하다 + -아/어야 돼요.
bg-18-02.sample: 손님이 오니까 오늘 방을 청소해야 돼요.
bg-18-02.why: 청소하다 conjugates to 청소해야 돼요 to express an obligation.

steps.en: I have to take cold medicine.
I have to eat dinner and take cold medicine.

ko: 내일은 아침 일찍 중요한 회사 회의가 있어요.
그래서 오늘 밤에는 열 시 전에 꼭 자야 돼요.
회의 자료도 가방에 미리 챙겨야 돼요.
en: Tomorrow morning there is an important company meeting early.
So tonight I must go to sleep before ten o'clock.
I also have to pack the meeting materials in my bag in advance.

bg-18-02.q: Why does the speaker have to go to sleep before ten o'clock tonight?
options: Because there is an early company meeting tomorrow morning
Because they are going on a fishing trip
bg-18-02.why: The passage says '내일은 아침 일찍 중요한 회사 회의가 있어요. 그래서 오늘 밤에는 열 시 전에 꼭 자야 돼요'.

bg-18-02.q: What else must the speaker prepare in advance?
options: Pack the meeting materials in the bag
bg-18-02.why: The passage states '회의 자료도 가방에 미리 챙겨야 돼요' (I also have to pack the meeting materials in my bag in advance).

items: I can express obligation and necessity using -아/어야 돼요 and -아/어야 해요
I can conjugate regular and 하다 verbs smoothly into -아/어야 돼요

items.ex: 방에 들어갈 때 신발을 벗어야 돼요.

items.en: may go / it is okay to go

items.ex: 식탁 위에 있는 주스를 마셔도 돼요?

bg-18-03.hint: You must take off your shoes.
bg-18-03.why: 벗다 attaches -어야 돼요 to express an obligation or rule.

bg-18-03.q: State that you may go home now because work or class is finished. Use 집 + -에 and 가다 + -아/어도 돼요.
bg-18-03.sample: 수업이 끝났으니까 이제 집에 가도 돼요.
bg-18-03.why: Use -아/어도 돼요 (가도 돼요) to grant permission.

a.d: Asks or grants permission: 'May I...?' or 'You may / It is okay to...'
ex: 여기 **앉아도 돼요**? / May I sit here?
이제 집에 **가도 돼요**. / You may go home now.

b.d: States a rule, duty, or necessity: 'I must...' or 'Do I have to...?'
ex: 신발을 **벗어야 돼요**. / You must take off your shoes.
오늘 숙제를 **해야 돼요**. / I have to do my homework today.

bg-18-03.tip: Look closely at the syllable before 돼요: 도 means 'even if / permission' (may), while 야 means 'only if / obligation' (must).

base.en: You must take off your shoes.

steps.en: You must take off your shoes at home.
You must take off your shoes in a Korean home.

ko: 마크 씨는 오늘 한국 친구 집에 처음 방문했어요.
현관에서 신발을 벗어야 돼요라고 친구에게 물어봤어요.
친구는 네, 신발은 여기서 벗어야 돼요, 그리고 거실에 편하게 앉아도 돼요라고 말했어요.
en: Mark visited a Korean friend's house for the first time today.
At the entrance, he asked his friend, 'Do I have to take off my shoes?'
His friend said, 'Yes, you must take off your shoes here, and you may sit comfortably in the living room.'

bg-18-03.q: What must Mark do at the entrance of his friend's house?
bg-18-03.why: The passage says '네, 신발은 여기서 벗어야 돼요' (Yes, you must take off your shoes here).

bg-18-03.q: What did the friend give Mark permission to do in the living room?
bg-18-03.why: The passage states '거실에 편하게 앉아도 돼요' (You may sit comfortably in the living room).

items: I can distinguish clearly between permission (-아/어도 돼요) and obligation (-아/어야 돼요)
I can ask and answer questions about rules and permissions in daily conversations

items.ex: 친구가 힘들 때 서로 도와야 돼요.
공항에 갈 때 여권을 챙겨야 돼요.

bg-18-04.why: 있다 attaches -어야 돼요 to express that having something is required.

bg-18-04.q: Ask if you may charge your phone here. Use 휴대폰 + object particle -을/를 and 충전하다 + -아/어도 돼요?
bg-18-04.why: 충전하다 becomes 충전해도 돼요? when politely asking permission to charge a device.

bg-18-04.hint: 돕다 is a ㅂ irregular verb that changes ㅂ to 오 before -아야 돼요!
bg-18-04.why: Before -아야 돼요, 돕다 conjugates to 도와야 돼요.

base.en: I have to turn in my homework.

steps.en: I have to turn in my homework by tomorrow.
I have to turn in my Korean homework by tomorrow.

ko: 저는 지금 카페에서 컴퓨터로 과제를 하고 있어요.
배터리가 부족해서 직원에게 여기서 충전기를 써도 돼요라고 물어봤어요.
오늘 밤 열두 시까지 과제를 꼭 제출해야 돼요.
en: I am doing an assignment on my computer at a cafe right now.
Because my battery was low, I asked a staff member, 'May I use my charger here?'
I must submit the assignment by twelve o'clock tonight.

bg-18-04.q: Why did the speaker ask the cafe staff for permission?
options: Because the computer battery was low and they wanted to use a charger
Because they wanted to bring a pet dog inside
Because they wanted to move a table outside
bg-18-04.why: The passage says '배터리가 부족해서 직원에게 여기서 충전기를 써도 돼요라고 물어봤어요'.

bg-18-04.q: When is the deadline for submitting the assignment?
bg-18-04.why: The passage states '오늘 밤 열두 시까지 과제를 꼭 제출해야 돼요' (I must submit the assignment by twelve tonight).

items: I can ask for permission in public places like cafes and subways
I can talk about deadlines and requirements using -아/어야 돼요
